facts.program: Xcel Energy Minnesota cold-climate air source heat pump
facts.claim: $2,000 for homes with Xcel gas or both Xcel gas and electric; $1,500 for Xcel electric-only homes (ducted or partly ducted); cold-climate mini-split $2,000
facts.eligibility: Xcel residential electric or natural gas customer in Minnesota; contractor in Xcel's Trade Partner Network (or DIY for a non-ducted mini-split). Cold climate: COP at 5°F of at least 1.75, on the NEEP list, and 5°F capacity at least 70% of 47°F capacity. Ducted: 15.2 SEER2, 10.0 EER2, 8.1 HSPF2 with quality installation. Cold-climate mini-split: 16.0 SEER2, 9.0 EER2, 9.5 HSPF2.
facts.dates: Installed and invoiced by Dec 31, 2026; applications accepted through Sep 30, 2027 (Xcel heat pump page)
facts.notes: Amounts come from Xcel's 2024-2026 Minnesota Rebate Summary (effective Jan 1, 2024). Xcel's live heat pump page lists the program dates but no amounts, and says to get a project quote. Xcel's live heating equipment page shows a $400 gas boiler rebate where this older sheet shows $250, so the sheet may be out of date. A newer sheet (dated 7/24/2025) is linked from the live page but its file would not open for our reader. Treated as unconfirmed.
